products.name: Azure AI Foundry & Azure OpenAI — Secure Enterprise Deployment — Commercial
products.short_description: Deploy Azure OpenAI and AI Foundry the enterprise way — private networking, managed identity, quotas, and governance from day one.
products.description:
Deploy Azure OpenAI and AI Foundry the enterprise way — private networking, managed identity, quotas, and governance from day one.

Teams spin up Azure OpenAI with public endpoints, shared keys, and no cost control — a data-exfiltration and bill-shock risk. This solution deploys Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI securely: private endpoints and network isolation, Entra managed-identity auth (no keys), model deployment and quota management, content filtering, and monitoring — a governed foundation for enterprise AI apps.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run automation (Python, IaC & scripts).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Azure AI Foundry hub/project + Azure OpenAI resource, deployed as code
  • Private endpoints, network isolation, and disabled public access
  • Entra managed-identity / RBAC auth (keyless), Key Vault for any secrets
  • Model deployments, versioning, quota (TPM) and rate-limit management
  • Content filtering, diagnostic logging, and cost/usage monitoring

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A secure, governed Azure OpenAI + AI Foundry foundation your teams build on — private, keyless, quota-managed, and monitored.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 4 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • AIFOUNDRY-Discovery.ps1 — read-only inventory of Azure OpenAI / Cognitive Services AI resources and their security posture
    • AIFOUNDRY-ModelSmokeTest.py — - keyless end-to-end proof that an app can call the model with NO key
    • AIFOUNDRY-Report.ps1 — read-only posture, usage, and cost report for the secure Azure OpenAI platform
    • AIFOUNDRY-Validate.py — - keyless, read-only posture validation of the deployed Azure OpenAI resource

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
